Wissens- und Zugangskriterien sind teilweise erfüllt, aber angesichts des zeitlichen Alibis ohne operative Täterrelevanz.
parsed.summary_en: Chiara Bernasconi has a strong, independently corroborated alibi: card and receipt records place her in Winterthur at 23:04 CEST — six minutes before the incident began in St. Gallen, some 40–50 minutes away — and again at 06:15 CEST the following morning, well after the device was detached. Physical presence at the scene during the entire incident window is effectively ruled out.
